title: Workplace Automation and Corporate Liquidity Policy
eligible_reason: Treatment is a continuous industry-level automation-exposure measure (SLAC, share of labor automatable) in Compustat firm-year regressions with time-varying firm controls and industry-by-year (or firm) FE; the quasi-experiment is the single-date 2011 Thailand hard-drive flood interacted with SLAC. No staggered binary adoption.
design_notes: code/Create_tables_figures.do: Table 1 validation regressions (occupation employment growth, robot installations on SLAC); Table 3 cash_holding on slac + $control_cash_holding (cash flow, NWC, capex, leverage, acquisitions, M/B, size, industry CF volatility, R&D, dividend payer, capital intensity) with fyear##sic2 FE or firm FE; Table 4 and Figure 6 SLAC x flooding/price shock among computer-reliant firms (2008-2016) with dynamic SLAC x year coefficients; Tables 5-7 heterogeneity and RTI comparisons.
data_access: partial (processed Compustat-merged firm-year file and public BLS/O*NET inputs shipped; Compustat licensed)
